description: A double ditched rectangular enclosure date to the Late Iron Age. Uncertain interpretation but a human leg was found in one corner, a tentative religious function has been suggested, and the RSRB has thus marked the site as a 'shrine'.
bibliography: Martin, Edward A., and Christopher Balkwill. Settlements on Hill-Tops: Seven Prehistoric Sites in Suffolk. East Anglian Archaeology, rept. no. 65. Ipswich, Suffolk: Suffolk County Planning Department, 1993.
Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Barnham (Suffolk).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
